stem: For A(−5) and B(7), point C divides segment AB internally in the ratio 2:1. Mark C on the number line.
solution: Internal division with m=2, n=1: $x=\frac{n a+m b}{m+n}$.

hints.text: Cross-multiply: each end is weighted by the other part of the ratio, then divide by the sum of the parts.
Only one point C is asked for.
Check the sign of a = −5 when substituting.
